description: This file processes parental control logs based on user-selected time frames and modes. It retrieves log entries via an external command, filters them according to time and type, and outputs the filtered data in JSON format along with writing a report file.

methods.name: switch
methods.description: Switch statement used for determining time range based on 'timef' parameter.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes external command to fetch log data.

methods.name: fopen
methods.description: Opens log and report files for reading and writing.

methods.name: feof
methods.description: Checks end-of-file status while reading log files.

methods.name: fgets
methods.description: Reads a line from the log file.

methods.name: strtotime
methods.description: Converts string time descriptions to Unix timestamps.

methods.name: json_encode
methods.description: Converts PHP array to JSON format for output.
